correctness.rationale: The proof handles every a>=1. The obstruction is strict: if L<min(a+2,5), both outer strip widths are <2, force a 4+4 partition of the eight unit squares, and the topmost right-strip and rightmost top-strip squares have overlapping x and y projections by strict L<5 and a>L-2. Separate L>=a+1 and explicit constructions yield sharpness. All endpoints included. Exact rational checker tests provided layouts but the infinite assertion follows analytically.
